device.modelDescription: writes to its worker's stdout and stderr, for the worker output bound test

actionList.name: say
actionList.description: Write one line to stdout and one to stderr, each with a terminal escape, and a line of 20 000 characters to stdout.

actionList.name: flood
actionList.description: Write input.mb megabytes to stdout in 64 KiB writes.

actionList.name: routes
actionList.description: Look for Node's own stdio streams or a MessagePort by every route the review named, and write through process._rawDebug.

actionList.name: logFlood
actionList.description: Call the runtime's logger input.n times with a 4 KiB message (reached through require.cache, as a module under --moduleSandbox off can).
